evidence: The structure and crystalline phases of the films were examined by X-ray diffractometer (XRD). Morphology and surface area determination were conducted by tapping-mode atomic force microscopy (AFM). The film thicknesses were measured with a spectroscopic ellipsometer. Absorption spectra of the films were measured with UV – VIS spectrophotometer. Water contact angles were measured with a contact angle measuring system. Photocatalytic degradation measurements were conducted with methylene blue (MB) tests.
